question_prompt: Find the agent(s) with the highest and the lowest salary.

SELECT t1.agent_id, t1.first, t1.last
 FROM (
     SELECT a.agent_id, a.first, a.last, a.salary, 
         MAX(a.salary) OVER () AS MaxSalary, 
            MIN(a.salary) OVER () AS MinSalary
     FROM agent a
     WHERE a.salary IS NOT NULL
 ) AS t1
 WHERE t1.salary = t1.MaxSalary OR t1.salary = t1.MinSalary;
